description:
fz has no is_function. Elixir's Kernel.is_function/1 and /2 (arity) are guards. Needed by Macro.escape to refuse a closure.

Design (proposal page ../fz-sc8.224.html, accepted):
- Type names `fun` and `function` (no arguments) in resolve.rs CONSTRUCTORS, both the top of the function axis (Descr::fun_top), as in Elixir's typespec table (function() is fun()).
- Kernel.is_function/1: `def is_function(_ :: fun), do: true; def is_function(_), do: false`.
- Kernel.is_function/2: a non-integer arity raises ArgumentError "errors were found at the given arguments:\n\n  * 2nd argument: not an integer\n", a negative one "... out of range\n" (checked before the value, as in Elixir); a function compares `fz_function_arity(f) == arity`, a new runtime export reading closure_arity; anything else is false. Arity >= 256 is just false.
- In a guard, the raise fails the guard.
Done when: oracle fixtures (next fz-sc8 number) match Elixir on interp/run/build for closures, local and remote captures and non-functions, guard forms, and the raises; a resolve test for both names; docs list the type names and the two tests.
title: is_function/1 and is_function/2 answer whether a value is a function
